Snapshot for "Where Are Tampa's Public Infrastructure Projects?"

Publisher: City of Tampa
Checked IDs: capital-projects and city-boundary
Projects source: https://tampa.maps.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=2226a20de08641e38cedd1c2d7cac69e
Boundary source: https://tampa.maps.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=ed03de89b95340359431d13bd2bc38f2
Both source items recorded as CC0 in the checked catalog.
Projects retrieved: 2026-10-25 02:35:57 UTC (October 24, Eastern time).

tampa-infrastructure.rds contains the original sf results, including source
provenance, saved as a list named capital_projects and tampa_boundary.
The vignette's download chunk reproduces both bounded requests. The save-data
chunk reproduces the list; save it to inst/extdata/tampa-infrastructure.rds
when deliberately updating
it. Both downloads were complete: 201 project features and one boundary
feature. No project geometry was missing. No IDs were deduplicated, and no
geometry was converted to another type.

The default vignette executes its mapping code on this snapshot when sf is
installed. inst/extdata/tampa-infrastructure-snapshot.png is the same map extracted
from the rendered vignette, for builds without the optional sf package.
Update that image and the dated prose when changing the snapshot. Source
metadata, query, field schemas, counts, and UTC timestamps remain available
through tbod_provenance() on each saved object. Live rendering never silently
substitutes this snapshot after a retrieval failure.

The snapshot and fallback image are installed in extdata, so installed vignette
sources can find them through system.file() without a repository checkout.
